title: LOGAN: Local Group Bias Detection by Clustering

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance disparity (e.g., accuracy and AUC gaps) between male and female demographic groups within local clusters of data for both toxicity classification in text and object classification in images.
Measuring performance disparity (e.g., accuracy and AUC gaps) between black and white racial groups within local clusters of data for text-based toxicity classification.
